decision.headline: This is a Binance deposit address. Recoverable through Binance support.

evidence.meaning: Nansen has this exact address labelled as a Binance customer deposit address.
Everything it receives is swept into Binance's own wallet.
All outflow goes to one counterparty: the sweep pattern of a deposit address.

action.title: Support ticket for Binance
action.text:
Subject: Funds sent to a Binance deposit address by mistake — recovery request

Hello Binance support,

On [date] I sent [amount and token] from my wallet [your address] to 0x42fbcba061088e71e4e785a5cd2d30cdc42d2023 on ethereum (transaction [transaction hash]).

This was a mistake. 0x42fbcba061088e71e4e785a5cd2d30cdc42d2023 is a Binance customer deposit address — Nansen labels it "🏦 Binance: Deposit [0x42fbcb]" and its transfers are swept into Binance's own wallets. It may belong to another Binance customer, or to an old account of mine. Please locate the account that owns this deposit address and either credit the funds to it (if it is mine) or return them to [your address].

Evidence (Nansen API):
- transaction-with-token-transfer-lookup → token_transfer_array[].from_address_label: 🏦 Binance: Deposit [0x42fbcb]
- transaction-with-token-transfer-lookup → token_transfer_array[].to_address_label: 🏦 Binance 14 [0x28c6c0]
- profiler/address/counterparties → volume_out_usd: 100% of $526,359 to 0x28c6…1d60

Account email: [your Binance account email]
Thank you,
[your name]
